history.content:
The capital of India is **New Delhi**.

**Key facts:**
- **New Delhi** serves as the seat of all three branches of the Government of India (Executive, Legislative, and Judiciary)
- It is part of the larger **National Capital Territory of Delhi (NCT)**
- New Delhi was designed by British architects Edwin Lutyens and Herbert Baker and inaugurated in 1931
- Major government buildings include Rashtrapati Bhavan (Presidential Residence), Parliament House, and the Supreme Court

The capital of Telangana is **Hyderabad**.

**Key facts:**
- **Hyderabad** serves as the capital of Telangana state
- It is also known as the "City of Pearls" and the "City of Nizams"
- Major landmarks include Charminar, Golconda Fort, and Hussain Sagar Lake
- Hyderabad is a major IT and pharmaceutical hub in India

**Important note:** 
- When Telangana was formed in 2014 (separated from Andhra Pradesh), Hyderabad was designated as the joint capital of both Telangana and Andhra Pradesh for a period of 10 years (until 2024)
- Andhra Pradesh has been developing **Amaravati** as its new capital city
